title: Concept: A declared name is one edit away from `firebase/php-jwt`
description: composer.json declares a declared package name in composer.json within one edit of `firebase/php-jwt`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Composer resolves these names against the configured repositories, so a name that only looks like the intended package installs foreign code. The name this rule expects is `firebase/php-jwt`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: Composer resolves these names against the configured repositories, so a name that only looks like the intended package installs foreign code. The name this rule expects is `firebase/php-jwt`.
